rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=14, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=search-20260619-01 iter-2 OOM RESCUE of hammernik_2017. iter-1 (batch_size=4) was NOT a real recon: it CUDA-OOMed in the _rho_prime RBF-bump loop at elapsed_s=72.5 on a 16GB RTX5000 (val_score blank in results.tsv), recorded as 0.0. The (B,F,H,W)=(4,16,512,512) x 31-bump RBF activation tensors held across 5 unrolled steps for autograd blew the card. SINGLE COHERENT memory-safety change for this rescue: batch_size 4->2, which halves every per-batch activation tensor in the bump loop -- the direct cause. NOTE: this hammernik_2017 solver is a PURE IMAGE-DOMAIN denoiser of the FBP (no projector in the unrolled loop) and does NOT read vn_checkpoint or vn_dc_norm (verified by grep over every cfg[...]/cfg.get(...) in the solver: only vn_T/vn_n_filters/vn_kernel/vn_n_bumps/vn_x_range/vn_*_init_std/vn_lambda_init/epochs/batch_size/lr/grad_clip/train_n/val_n/seed/max_train_s are consumed). Those two knobs belong to the SIBLING projector-in-loop hammernik_vn solver; passing them here would be silently ignored, so they are intentionally omitted -- the operative fix this solver honors is the batch halving (+ grad_clip=1.0 already present for VN-family NaN-skip stability). Budget: HARD 20-min train+score; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (321px detector-geometry FOV default, no fov= override; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps, bg_target=truth). batch=2 ~doubles steps/epoch, so epochs 40->14 (mirrors the sibling hammernik_vn iter-1 that scored 0.805 in 1296s); max_train_s=1000 (16.7min in-solver wall) is the binding constraint and leaves ~3min for score(214)+figure under the 30min SLURM kill. capacity kept modest (vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16). HYPOTHESIS: with batch halved the activation footprint drops ~2x, the OOM is avoided, hammernik_2017 produces its FIRST FINITE recon landing near/above the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor (sibling hammernik_vn hit 0.805) -- the first valid datapoint for this solver under the corrected metric.
